{"requirements": [
{"id": 1, "text": "The game is for three players."},
{"id": 2, "text": "Every player starts with 0 points."},
{"id": 3, "text": "The players take turns."},
{"id": 4, "text": "In each turn, the current player must throw a dice."},
{"id": 5, "text": "The system adds the dice count to the current player's points."},
{"id": 6, "text": "After each turn, the system prints the dice count and the current player's points."},
{"id": 7, "text": "The game ends after 12 turns."},
{"id": 8, "text": "The game also terminates if one player has significantly more points than the others."},
{"id": 9, "text": "If the dice count is 1, the current player shall decide whether to re-roll the dice."},
{"id": 10, "text": "The system shall display a congratulations message for the winner."},
{"id": 11, "text": "The player point colors shall always be red for player 1, green for player 2, and blue for player 3."},
{"id": 12, "text": "If a player's points are sufficient to win, his point color shall turn purple."},
{"id": 13, "text": "If the current player throws a 6, their turn shall end."},
{"id": 14, "text": "If the dice count is 2, the system shall triple it. If the dice count is even, the system shall halve it."},
{"id": 15, "text": "The system shall check the players' points at any point in the game. If they turn equal, the system shall print: 'Equality!'."},
{"id": 16, "text": "The system shall decide the players' turn order at the beginning of the game."},
{"id": 17, "text": "The system shall ask for each player's name. If 'Computer' is entered, the system shall print 'Name cannot be Computer' and ask for the name again."},
{"id": 18, "text": "If the dice count is high, the system shall throw again and multiply both dice counts."},
{"id": 19, "text": "When a player's points get above 5 points, his point color shall turn purple."},
{"id": 20, "text": "In each turn, the current player shall have the option to skip their turn."},
{"id": 21, "text": "If a player throws the same value multiple times in a row, the system shall reset their points to 0."},
{"id": 22, "text": "If two players have the same amount of points, the game shall not end until one player has more points than the other."},
{"id": 23, "text": "After the game has ended, the system shall be able to print the players' points and the winner."},
{"id": 24, "text": "After the game has ended, one player shall be the winner."},
{"id": 25, "text": "If the players decide to play again, the players shall be ordered in a certain way."}
] 
}
